tests.title: Add, move and delete shelf sub-articles over three turns
prompt: add a shelf to the middle of the left-most carcass of the wardrobe
move the shelf inside the right-most cabinet down by 500 mm
delete the shelf from the middle cabinet
tests.expect: turn 1: get-interior-design-options on group ce854b3e-90d6-4e65-ba7b-461e125cc8da, then one add-interior-fitting of a compatible FixedShelf into left root ab0737ab-a681-48ed-995b-46ee788a2329, at about half the height of the cabinet's interior; the original left shelf 037ab69e-8475-4418-b6db-df6738b91df1 stays; shelves left / middle / right 2 / 1 / 1. turn 2: one move-interior-fitting of right shelf c585292d-26f7-41da-92ff-50a278161f95 in right root 22e7519d-4218-46e4-b1a5-5c92934ad420, in its current parent, with an insertPosition 500 mm lower in y than its measured position, x and z unchanged; the returned actual placement is 500 mm lower, a library adjustment is reported; shelves 2 / 1 / 1. turn 3: one delete-interior-fittings of only middle shelf 19d07551-c89b-43ee-8caa-e4c2bef10fb6 in middle root 7b8bd635-7f19-4e3c-b280-95b91d4c4916; shelves 2 / 0 / 1, the two left shelves and the moved right shelf where turns 1 and 2 put them. Recreation may change instance IDs; the agent uses the returned IDs or discovers them again. Every turn keeps the three cabinets, their placement, finishes and docking; no cabinet or whole group is deleted, no separate delete/add commands for the move.

tests.title: Image: kitchen on the left-hand wall
tests.prompt: create a kitchen like the one in the image on the left-hand wall of the room
tests.expect: the model fetches the skill image-planning beside the kitchen skill and plans the kitchen of the image on the left-hand wall, in the order of the image; the backsplash visible in the image is generated when the library supports it, with its intended color and height applied after generation; the final answer accurately reports any remaining omission

tests.title: Image: kitchen in the back right corner
tests.prompt: create a kitchen like the one shown in the image, in the back right corner of the room
tests.expect: the model fetches the skill image-planning beside the kitchen skill and plans the L-shaped kitchen of the image around the back right corner, one leg on the back wall and one on the right wall: the long leg with the tall units at its far end - among them one tall unit with the microwave built in above the oven - base units, a drawer unit below the hob, a chimney range hood above the hob and a wall unit on each side of the hood; the short leg with the sink unit at its end; anthracite fronts and a light oak worktop; no tall unit and no wall unit in front of the window (back wall, x -450 to 1650, bottom 950) - the base units may run below it - and nothing in the door opening (right wall, z 280 to 1180); the image shows no backsplash; the final answer accurately reports any remaining omission

tests.title: Image: planning on the right-hand wall
tests.prompt: create a planning as to the one shown in the picture on the right-hand wall of the room.
tests.expect: the model fetches the skill image-planning beside the kitchen skill and plans the kitchen of the image: one row of five tall units against the right-hand wall, in the order of the image, between the back right corner and the door (right wall, z 280 to 1180), clear of the door opening - white fronts, two neighbouring tall units with oak fronts, one white tall unit with the oven built in; and a separate island group of base units free in the room in front of the row, parallel to it with a walkway between, carrying the hob and the sink; white fronts and a light grey stone worktop on the island; no wall units; the image shows no backsplash; the final answer accurately reports any remaining omission

tests.title: Image only, no text
tests.expect: the model decides what to plan; the chat sends the image with the image prompt of the planner, which names the skill image-planning; the model fetches image-planning, and the kitchen skill for its checks, and plans the galley kitchen of the image as close to it as possible in the narrow wing of the L-shaped room, whose end wall has the window as in the image: one row along the left wall (x -780) from the window wall towards the door - the tall fridge unit, the sink unit, the dishwasher, the oven below the hob and drawer units, wall units above - and opposite it, along the wall at x 2220, base units with a worktop and a wall unit above them; under the window (top wall, x -330 to 1770, bottom 950) at most base units or a worktop, no tall unit and no wall unit in front of it; the passage between the two doors (left and right wall, z -210 to 690) stays free: no unit in a door opening or in the swing of the right door (x 3530 to 4420); cream fronts and a walnut worktop; the backsplash visible in the image is generated when the library supports it, with its intended color and height applied after generation; the final answer accurately reports any remaining omission
